In September 2025 I had my asthma review with the nurse whose name she told me was 'Claire'. I'm not sure of the spelling. She also did a diabetic review. I've been a type 1 diabetic for 42 years. She asked if I had the Freestyle Libre diabetic sensor fitted. I said that I didn't. She asked me if I would like one. I said yes and said to her that I had asked for one a number of years ago based on the information that the diabetic nurse at Warrington hospital had told me. The diabetic consultant at the hospital and my GP 'stitched' me up each saying it was the others responsibility to authorise it. So it never got authorised. She said that she could fit it at the Surgery. All I need to do is make an appointment. So I did, specifically saying that I wanted the Freestyle Libre to be fitted.

Coming back to today. When I went in there was a different nurse there who said she couldn't fit the Freestyle Libre and anyway they don't keep them at the surgery. I said how disappointed I was. She then went out of the room and talked to the GP. The discussion she had with him went along the lines that since my diabetic control was good a number of years ago there was no need for the Freestyle Libre back then. And since it is good currently there is still no need today.

The diabetic nurse that I saw in September is the expert in Diabetes, not the GP or the nurse today who admitted that she couldn't fit them which indicated to me she wasn't an expert in diabetes management. So they have gone against the decision of the diabetes nurse with more experience. I'm not sure that the GP and the nurse's argument I saw today even holds because there is always room for better control with the Freestyle Libre and therefore improved health. Am I being penalised for having good diabetic control?

They did offer to arrange a consultation with the diabetic consultant at the hospital. I think I know where that may end up going by what happened a couple of years ago.

I'm very disappointed with the whole way this has been handled. Why couldn't a rearranged appointment with 'Claire' be made so that she could fit the Freestyle
